job.title: Data Engineer I
job.pay_full: $101,300 – $160,000 a year base salary (Bellevue, WA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon's Global Logistics (GL) Exports team supports Amazon's goal of offering customers worldwide cross-border selection at competitive prices. It builds the data infrastructure and analytics behind decisions for customers, sellers and vendors in international trade and logistics. As a Data Engineer I you build and maintain data solutions, work with large datasets, design data models and automate pipelines, alongside analysts, data scientists and engineers. The team values collaboration, continuous learning, mentorship and operational excellence.
duties: Design, build and maintain data pipelines and ETL workflows that ingest, transform and store data from many sources at scale
Create and optimize physical data models: schema design, partitioning, indexing and query tuning
Write secure, testable, well-documented code in SQL, Python or Scala to automate data processing
Work with business analysts, data scientists and engineers to turn requirements into technical solutions
Monitor pipelines, troubleshoot root causes and fix defects to keep data reliable
Take part in design discussions and code reviews
needs: Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with one or more query languages (e.g. SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
Experience with one or more scripting languages (e.g. Python, KornShell)
Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda and IAM roles and permissions
nice: Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark and EMR
Experience with an ETL tool such as Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI or DataStage
details.benefits: Base salary $101,300 – $160,000 a year (Bellevue, WA). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, Basic Life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the application, interview and onboarding process for candidates with disabilities
